items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: shadcn/ui's Dialog on bedrock. Native <dialog>, no portal, no overlay element, no focus-trap JavaScript. Uncontrolled — install dialog-controlled if React needs to own the open state.

items.name: dialog-controlled
items.title: Dialog (controlled)
items.description: The same Dialog against bedrock's controlled entry point. Takes a required `open` prop that can refuse an open or a close.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: shadcn/ui's AlertDialog on bedrock's Dialog, with role="alertdialog". Action and Cancel are both close buttons.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A <label> that does not select its own text on a double click.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: One element, role="separator" or removed from the tree when decorative.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: One element with the aspect-ratio property, not a padding-bottom wrapper.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A real <input type="checkbox">. The tick is a masked ::before under :checked, so there is no Indicator element.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A checkbox with role="switch"; the thumb is a ::before rather than an element.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A real <progress>. Omit value for indeterminate; the fill is ::-webkit-progress-value.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: An <input type="range">. Single value, because a range input has one thumb.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Real radios sharing a name, which is the whole of roving focus.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: <details> and <summary>: opens before hydration and without JavaScript.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: <details name> for single-open exclusivity, so no effect closes the siblings.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Roving tab list. The unselected panel is unmounted, so leaving a tab resets it.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button with aria-pressed. State is [aria-pressed=true], not [data-state=on].

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Toggle buttons sharing one tab stop.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: An with a fallback shown only when it fails to load.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Native scrolling styled with scrollbar-width and scrollbar-color.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Top layer plus anchor positioning: no portal, no z-index, no scroll recalculation.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: popover="hint", so it layers above an open menu instead of closing it.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A hoverable popover whose trigger may be an <a>, which link previews need.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A real <select> under appearance: base-select, so a phone still gets its own picker.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Popover plus roving focus and typeahead. Submenus need no configuration.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: The same menu anchored to the pointer. Root is the trigger area.
